implementation: Pure decide/explain/coach rules with OpenCV+zxing-cpp perception and a cached VLM damage call (fail-safe to QUARANTINE without credentials); scan UI, review queue, append-only overrides and an events feed on one FastAPI app
notes: In-process handle() for the orchestrator; uvicorn agents.receiving.app:app --port 8101 serves the UI plus GET /health and POST /run. Damage needs OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY (or VLM_API_KEY); without one every photo scan fails safe to LOW_CONF_DAMAGE -> QUARANTINE. See README for eval numbers and limits.
